reference_business_values.receipts: Choice forward/reverse/restored/held each bind their exact Boolean and current model event to original actions2/4/5/12; primary request binds action6; disclosure quiet intervals bind actions1/8; replacement quietness binds successful caller update action10, not the subsequent sweep11.
reference_business_values.guards: Initial eligibility is true. The identity replacement has both guards false; status remains Seal needs attention before and after held acknowledgement. Thus H1 prospectively exercises seal priority without an enabled primary under the hold.
reference_business_values.copy: All required expanded heading/body assertions match the eight actual caller notes in caller order. Exact title, destination+separator+temperature subtitle and control labels match the independent state simulation.
reference_business_values.disabled_constraints: No disabled attempt is credited as callback dispatch. Generic verdict requires unique enabled native control and successful xcui_tap/compose_onclick; updates require caller_fixture_update and same-process/input/event provenance.

RTL_review.environment: H1 is400x600 light RTL with iOS large/Android1.0; fixture and case-specific approved environment canonical hashes match.
RTL_review.native_boundary: Actual geometry rule uses inset_right on distinct real statusText/status semantic allocations, gte16pt/dp, accessibility_box, semantic basis, no implicit tolerance. Frozen native_geometry supports right-edge arithmetic on unique fully visible boxes from one coherent original frame.
RTL_review.pixel_strip: Independent status-leading-clear atom samples physical-right [0.96,0,1,1] with minimum_support1.0 and zero channel tolerance. The status role sample is also mirrored to [0.965,0.2,0.988,0.8].
RTL_review.other_roles: Primary/surface/canvas solid strips and ink interior are still distinct valid role samples under their declared rectangular solid regions; semantic/native sample eligibility remains future evidence.
RTL_review.illustration: Viewed private reference.png and inspected reference.svg. Ink and text align to the right; status text is16 illustration units from the band right edge. This static illustration is not native geometry, computed font or pixel acceptance evidence.
RTL_review.source_only: Private/public palette, geometry expectations, qualitative questions, exact API contracts, source-audit propositions and103 source definitions agree. Uncapped lines, noninteractive carriers, production state ownership, no nested scroller/blank spacer and matching primary content-shape construction remain source gates; rendered wrapping, geometry, shape and dispatch remain separate runtime MUSTs.

original_caller_preservation.limit: The allowed current private reference retains original caller SHA pins, and the actual complete fixture/models match them. No historical private-v1 reference/fixture was opened because that historical path was not in this supplemental authorized input scope; original caller provenance is assessed through these sealed pins, not a separate historical-byte comparison.

public_API_consistency.bridge_semantics: Bridges only decode current supplied caller values and forward actual production callbacks; no local business state, substitute UI or identity wrapper. Original observer make/Content call shapes remain correct.
public_API_consistency.source_only_contract: Exact Swift public immutable values/conformances/initializers/View/body and Kotlin data-class/val/Composable/Modifier default contracts are retained and separately source audited.
public_API_consistency.minimum14: Same source-only availability audit and pinned future real AlertToast module emission/unchanged public bridge typecheck at14 as the public design. No source/API SDK checker was run; legacy packaging/link/runtime remains unverified.
